name: Friday Shop Ride
schedule: Every Friday, 7:00 am, from Bicycle Haüs in Old Town Scottsdale. A loop around Paradise Valley that finishes at La Grande Orange on 40th Street in Phoenix; everyone rides home from there.
visitor_notes: It ends at La Grande Orange (4410 N 40th St, Phoenix), not back at the shop. Plan your own way home from there.
description: Bicycle Haüs's Friday morning shop ride. It rolls from the shop in Old Town Scottsdale at 7:00 am, loops around Paradise Valley and finishes at La Grande Orange in Arcadia, about 20 miles. Social and no-drop.
evidence: Robert rides it every Friday. On Oct 8, 2026 he confirmed the 7:00 am start at the shop, the Paradise Valley loop to La Grande Orange, about 20 miles, social and no-drop. ENVE's profile of the shop names its Friday Ride; the shop's own site doesn't post a schedule.

refresh.notes: Not posted on the shop's site. Robert rides it every Friday, so re-check by asking him, or the shop directly. The shop can send changes through "I run this ride" on the ride page.
